evidence.quote: HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :- 1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 55~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT. 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )

findings.comment: The title block field 'heat_treatment' is set to '---', which conflicts with Note N3 that explicitly specifies case hardening to 55-60 HRC. This ambiguity can lead to the heat treatment step being overlooked during manufacturing planning. The designer should update the title block 'heat_treatment' field to reflect the specified case hardening or remove the redundant/contradictory entry.
findings.recommended_correction: Update the title block 'heat_treatment' field to specify 'Case Hardened 55-60 HRC' to match Note N3.
